India's GDP growth was about 9.7% in FY22 and 7.6% in FY23, then 9.2% in FY24 and 6.5% in FY25. Those are the last four full years. FY21 was a fall of 5.8% because of Covid, so FY22's jump is a rebound. Figures are rounded and from my own knowledge, not a live source, and FY26 isn't final yet.
